speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever following antibiotic treatment for sinusitis; could you please describe the severity of the flank pain and specify which antibiotic you were prescribed?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any pain or burning when you urinate, or have you noticed any changes in the color or frequency of your urine? I also need to know if you have a history of kidney stones or urinary tract infections.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you experience any joint pain or swelling along with the rash? I also need to know if you have noticed any swelling in your legs or face, or if your urine output has decreased significantly.

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of amoxicillin use followed by a rash, fever, and flank pain, I suspect acute interstitial nephritis. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis. REQUEST TEST: Serum Creatinine.
